name: Pricing effective dates resolution
expected: Pricing Effective Dates step resolves PricingDate from EffectiveDate/contract/line StartDate; a FUTURE-dated line reads the future-effective pricebook so a Feb-effective line prices off the Feb pricebook (different list from the Jan pricebook). Differential observable = same product priced at two different dates yields two different list prices.
actual: V21 date-resolution chain is present and runs clean, but the catalog's differential observable CANNOT be demonstrated because FortraUAT has NO date-effective pricebook data. (1) Proc wiring confirmed in live V21 (versionNumber=21, v21_fresh.json): Contacted Pricing step idx32 'ContactedPricing75' native assignment seeds PricingDate<-EffectiveDate; Price Book Entries step idx96 resolves PBE via Price_Book_Entry_Decision_Table_v2 (LookUpId 0lDa50000007BErEAM) keyed Product/Pricebook/SellingModel/Currency; Pricing Effective Dates step idx97 'PricingEffectiveDates' native AssignmentElement filters PBE where EffectiveFrom=PricingDate; Pricing Setting step idx98 native PricingSettings keyed on ItemContract. (2) But PricebookEntry has NO EffectiveFrom/EffectiveTo/EffectiveDate columns (INVALID_FIELD on query+describe) and there is no EffectivePricebookEntry object - date-effective pricebook feature is NOT enabled in this org. (3) Empirical proof on real data: quote 0Q0WC000002DWNV0A4 has product 'Unlimited Classification' (Product2Id 01tWC000009oPyxYAE) on TWO lines with different StartDates (2026-03-01 and 2026-04-15); both resolve to the SAME PricebookEntry 01uWC0000043adxYAA and SAME list=250 / PBE.UnitPrice=250. Exactly one list price per product/SM/currency regardless of date. (4) Date-resolution DOES function downstream: Force-reprice of control quote 0Q0WC000003FPvd0AG returned isSuccess=true/errorResponse=[]; its TermDefined lines' StartDate 2026-06-29 correctly drove EndDate 2027-06-28 and PTC=1 (proration honors the resolved date). So PricingDate resolution is wired+correct; only the Feb-vs-Jan PRICE-VARIANCE observable is missing from org data.
evidence: Live V21 proc: Data/pricing-v21-validation/live/v21_fresh.json (versionNumber 21; steps idx96 PriceBookEntries, idx97 PricingEffectiveDates EffectiveFrom=PricingDate, idx98 PricingSetting, idx32 ContactedPricing75 EffectiveDate->PricingDate). proposedFix: Not a defect to fix in V21. To make I-05's differential observable TESTABLE would require enabling the native RLM date-effective pricebook model (EffectivePricebookEntry / EffectiveFrom-EffectiveTo dated PBE rows) and seeding at least one product with two date-effective list prices straddling a future line StartDate - a catalog/data-model change outside V21 and outside validation scope (no PBE/decision-table edits permitted). Absent that, the step is verified-present and inert-but-correct.
notes: proc_mechanism (Pricing Effective Dates; Pricing Setting; Contacted Pricing PricingDate seed; reads PBE as-of ServiceStartDate) all confirmed wired in live V21 and execute without error; downstream proration/EndDate derivation honors the line StartDate (control 0Q0WC000003FPvd0AG: Start 2026-06-29 -> End 2027-06-28, PTC 1).
